subject: Request: blended credits + discounted commit for Cleardock POC
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@cleardock.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cleardock.com, Mark Turner <mark.turner@cleardock.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC timing + ask: combined credits + short-term discount?

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo this week — the team at Cleardock is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the embedding quality. We have one constraint: our clinical data team needs an extra 3 weeks to finish test-harnessing patient de-identification, which pushes the POC endpoint date out.

To keep the pilot economics viable for us internally I'm asking whether Redwood would consider a blended approach:
- 150k free token-equivalent credits applied during the 6-week POC window (to account for re-runs), and
- a short-term promotional discount (we were thinking 25%) on usage over the first 90 days should we move to onboarding.

If possible, we'd also like an invoiceable PO and a simple mutual action plan so procurement can move quickly. I've attached a one-page scope and a rough cost model for what we expect.

We appreciate any flexibility — Cleardock is evaluating two vendors and a small pricing concession + credits will materially influence our selection. Happy to hop back on a quick call.

Best,
Elaine Park
Head of Data Platforms | Cleardock Therapeutics
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@cleardock.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC timing + ask: combined credits + short-term discount?

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments.

We can absolutely discuss a blended package. Initial proposal from my side (pending exec approval):
- 150,000 token-equivalent credits applied to the POC period (6 weeks),
- 20% promotional usage discount for the first 90 days post-POC, provided Cleardock signs an onboarding commit of at least $50k ARR-equivalent within 30 days of POC close,
- We will provide a PO/invoice path and a one-page mutual action plan to get procurement moving.

I'll loop in Marissa and Vivek to confirm commercial approval and handle DocuSign/PO steps. Rafael, can you confirm whether the 150k token credit maps to a $X credit on our billing model? I'm attaching a quick cost model for reference.

Thanks — we want to make this easy for your procurement team.

—Avery
Avery Johnson
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: POC timing + ask: combined credits + short-term discount? — Exec approval request

Vivek / Rafael — forwarding Elaine's request and Avery's draft proposal. Quick background: Cleardock is a strategic early-career account in oncology informatics; large pilot potential (we're tracking $600k ARR expansion motion). They are evaluating two vendors; pricing + onboarding friction are the gating items.

Ask: signoff to approve a combined concession: 150k token credit for the POC + promotional discount on initial usage. Proposal for exec consideration:
- 150k token credit (one-time; non-recurring),
- 25% discount for first 90 days OR 20% if we require $50k commit (we can choose which is easier to sell),
- PO path and DocuSign ready; we will include standard data residency and SOC2 language.

Justification: high win probability, procurement friendly, and low short-term cost given our unit economics with caching/quantization. This is time-sensitive — procurement wants a final proposal by EOD Monday.

Attachments: cleardock_poc_scope.pdf, cleardock_cost_model.xlsx

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Director | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 11:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC timing + ask: combined credits + short-term discount? — Exec approval request

Thanks for the context. Approve the credit component. Conditions on the discount: we can offer a 20% promotional discount for the first 90 days if Cleardock signs a minimum commit of $50k within 30 days of POC completion. Do not give 25% without a revenue commitment.

Rafael — please confirm how 150k tokens map to a billable credit and the accounting treatment (one-time contra-revenue vs. promo credit). Also ensure deal is recorded in HubSpot and the discount is timeboxed with an expiry clause.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC timing + ask: combined credits + short-term discount? — credit mapping and ops

Confirmed: 150,000 token-equivalent credit maps to a $12,500 contra credit on our billing model (using current avg unit cost). Accounting prefers recording as a one-time promotional credit (contra-revenue). I will create the HubSpot deal note under DEAL-7832 and add the PO/invoice checklist.

Operational notes:
- We should attach the credit as a one-line item on the first invoice (description: POC promotional credit),
- Discount should be stored as a time-limited SKU in billing (20% for 90 days) tied to the deal id,
- Need a signed commitment PO for $50k minimum to enable the 20% discount.

I'll also prepare a simple DocuSign draft and send Marissa the link.

Rafael Mendes
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@cleardock.com>
Cc: avery_johnson@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, procurement@cleardock.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC timing + ask: combined credits + short-term discount?

Hi Elaine — thanks for your patience. Following internal review we can offer the following, conditional on a signed PO/commit:

1) 150k token-equivalent POC credit (one-time; $12,500 value) applied to the POC period.
2) 20% promotional discount on billable usage for the first 90 days after POC, conditional on Cleardock signing a minimum $50k commit within 30 days of POC close.

Next steps: I’ve drafted a DocuSign offer here: https://www.docusign.net/cleardock-poc-accept (link expires in 7 days). Rafael will include the credit line on the first invoice. If procurement prefers a PO-first flow, please send the PO to invoices@redwood.ai and we’ll route for priority activation.

If that looks good I can get the DocuSign over today so procurement hits approve.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Director | Redwood Inference
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@cleardock.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cleardock.com, Mark Turner <mark.turner@cleardock.com>, avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC timing + ask: combined credits + short-term discount?

Marissa — that path works for us. Two quick clarifications before we sign:
1) Will the credit be applied automatically to POC invoices or do we need to reference a credit code?
2) Can we get a one-page statement that the 20% discount is time-limited and contingent on the $50k commit (for our procurement/legal sign-off)?

Procurement will review the DocuSign today and aim to return the PO by Wednesday. Once we have the PO we’ll finalize timelines for the extended POC window.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Head of Data Platforms | Cleardock Therapeutics
